newsitem.title: USA: Dell cuts OptiPlex prices up to 16 percent.
newsitem.headline: Dell cuts OptiPlex prices up to 16 percent.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp. Wednesday cut prices for the fourth time this year on its line of network-ready Dell OptiPlex corporate desktop personal computers, by up to 16 percent.
Prices on some OptiPlex PCs have fallen as much as 50 percent since January.

Dell said the biggest cuts are on configurations for Microsoft Windows 95 and Windows NT Workstation 4.0. The company said many of these systems now are already priced up to 34 percent less than comparable systems offered by competitors.
Austin, Texas-based Dell's stock rose $2.50 to $73.50 on Nasdaq.
